description: This file defines the AgentWorkspaceConfig enum with static methods for reading and setting the 'workspace' configuration within a nested dictionary structure representing a configuration root. It encapsulates logic for retrieving and modifying workspace-related settings in a structured way.

methods.name: workspace(from:)
methods.description: Retrieves the 'workspace' string value from a nested dictionary representing the root configuration.

methods.name: setWorkspace(in:workspace:)
methods.description: Sets or removes the 'workspace' value in the nested configuration dictionary, updating internal structures accordingly.
